text:
jess: quick heads-up — customer on CF Workers hit a hard fail when using our JS SDK. error: `ReferenceError: process is not defined` and `require('crypto')` blew up.

anna: ah okay can you paste the stack / minimal repro?

jess: yup. this is from their bundle step with wrangler: 
```
> ReferenceError: process is not defined
    at Object.resolve (node:internal/modules/cjs/loader:xxxx)
    at Function.Module._resolveFilename (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
    at Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
    at require (internal/modules/cjs/helpers.js:xx)
    at Object.<anonymous> (/worker/node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs:12:20)
```
They import `import Redwood from 'redwood'` in an ESM worker, but rollup/esbuild ended up picking the CJS build which requires `process` and `crypto`.

mike: sounds like we need a worker-friendly entrypoint + conditional exports. CF Workers don't have Node globals (process, Buffer) and they have `globalThis.crypto.subtle` instead of `require('crypto').webcrypto`.

samir: agreed. we should:
- publish an ESM build (module) that avoids Node APIs
- add `exports` map with a `./worker` entry that bundlers can pick
- include a small runtime shim for `crypto` fallback detection

ben: sample package.json conditional exports idea: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
Then in README say: `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'` or let bundlers pick `worker` automatically via resolution hints.

jess: nice. what about TypeScript types? we can't ship multiple `types` per entry, so maybe keep types generic and add `types` reference in the worker file via `/// <reference types="./types-worker" />`?

anna: instead of separate types, we can keep one `.d.ts` that uses `declare module 'redwood/worker'` augmentation. simpler for consumers.

mike: for the crypto shim, simple pattern: 
```
const webcrypto = typeof globalThis?.crypto?.subtle !== 'undefined'
  ? globalThis.crypto
  : (typeof require !== 'undefined' && require('crypto')?.webcrypto);
```
Then in worker build tree-shake out the `require('crypto')` path so bundlers won't include it. mark it under `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` guard.

samir: also watch for `Buffer` usage — we should avoid `Buffer.from` in the worker build. use `Uint8Array` helpers.

devex-bot: build failed on PR #412: linux-node-16 — failure in `bundle:cloudflare` step. log: 
```
error: Could not resolve "crypto" in "node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs"
```
@samir assigned by CI.

ben: quick repro trick for maintainers: use Miniflare 2 with `wrangler dev` or `miniflare --modules` so you catch ESM resolution issues locally.

jess: action items: @samir open PR that adds `index.worker.mjs` (no node deps) + `exports` map; @jess add CF worker test harness in `integration/worker/` that runs in CI (Miniflare); @anna update the SDK README with migration notes. I'll pair on the types bit.

samir: will do, aiming for small change: copy index.mjs -> index.worker.mjs, replace Node-specific bits with guards, drop Buffer usage. PR by EOD tomorrow.

anna: can we also add a short test in `devex/samples/workers/` showing `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'` + `await client.generate(...)` so customers have a drop-in example?

mike: yes pls. thanks y'all. this will cut down our support tickets. :thumbsup:

jess: thanks — big win for edge DX if we get this right. :shipit:
